text.p: Tropical storm Willie will be an increasing risk to shipping in the South China Sea, southeast of Hainan island. Top winds are currently 55 mph but they may increase to 75 mph during the period. Willie is expected to drift towards the east this period.

Typhoon Violet is mainly a strong risk to shipping in the region southeast and east of Okinawa during the next 48-72 hours. Top winds are currently 100 mph and they weaken only slightly, to 90 mph, during the next 72 hours. In addition the islands near Okinawa can expect rough surf and beach errosion during this period. Violet is also being watched in case it comes further north. This would put the main islands of Japan Tropical storm Tom is mostly a risk to shipping as it is 860 miles southeast of Tokyo. Winds are currently 60 mph and they should weaken further as the system moves out to sea.
Tropical Depression 01C will be a moderate threat to shipping as it tracks westward well south of Hawaii the next few days. This system has top winds near 35 mph.
